name: Leucadia Pizza Point Loma
notes: first-party multi-location chain site (Leucadia Pizzeria & Italian Restaurants); cached branch-specific page mentions 'Point Loma' 12 times confirming this is the Point Loma location's menu (worklist address 4161 Voltaire Street #A; the literal street name did not appear on the page, but the neighborhood name and menu content are Point-Loma-specific, not a generic/other-branch page). Price cent-endings are highly scattered across ~35 distinct values with no repeating divisor or narrow rotating set (subtraction test: differences between size variants of the same dish are irregular, e.g. Cheese Pizza scaling, consistent with genuine independently-set menu prices, not a computed fee). A subset of items (mostly 'Create Your Pizza' build-your-own toppings and fountain drinks) were printed on-site with a trailing '+' meaning 'starting at this price, increases with size/toppings' — the '+' was moved into each dish's description as '(starting price; varies with size/toppings)' and the printed base price itself used verbatim in the price field, per the no-price-construction rule.
